[LHYD.8.2] The kwarg is spelled `filter`, not `where`: `where` is the
LHS-predicate keyword and reusing it here would overload it. Its
grammatical shape is a regular kwarg (`filter: <expression>`).

Both spellings are reserved words ([LLEX.9.5]) — `filter` is a
language-defined kwarg name, not an author-chosen one.
